load_measurement.honest_limitation: No tenant was contacted. These are exact counts of what the engine WOULD issue against a synthetic tenant, not latency measured against Microsoft. Both columns run the CURRENT collectors, so only the execution topology differs; the pre-Phase-9 PowerShell session count is modelled as one session per reviewed operation, which is exactly what the old code did.
load_measurement.excluded: 2 of 43 collectors reject the synthetic tenant's shape outright (entra.governance.pim_role_policies, entra.groups.groups, plus entra.roles.admin_license_footprint at larger sizes). They are named in the report and excluded from BOTH columns equally, so the delta stays meaningful and the exclusion is visible.

independent_review.codex: UNAVAILABLE. Rate-limited until 2026-09-07 12:38 -- the same limit Phase 7 and Phase 8 recorded. This is the THIRD consecutive phase with no Codex review, and it should not be treated as normal.
independent_review.substitute: Gemini (Antigravity CLI, gemini-3.5-flash) reviewed engine/worker/tasks.py and engine/worker/dispatcher.py, the two highest-risk modules.
independent_review.substitute_outcome: 4 candidate defects returned; 3 confirmed and fixed (a group failure took the FIRST member's reason code and retryability; a rolling deploy could create both a per-result row and a collection row for the same control; a pending non-ready control could become an unpublishable collection row that failed the whole scan on retry exhaustion). The fourth, a message inconsistency between the single-control and grouped shapes, was confirmed as a narrower defect and fixed: the terminal message said 'after retries' even when no retry was attempted.
independent_review.in_session: A six-dimension adversarial review of the landed code, with three independent refuters per finding on distinct lenses. 38 candidate findings; see review.json.
independent_review.verification_gap: 12 of 120 agents hit a session limit, leaving three findings with zero refuter verdicts. All three were adjudicated by hand, all three were real, and all three are fixed.
independent_review.honest_limitation: This substitution is weaker than the standing Codex instruction. Phase 7's and Phase 8's integration work also went un-reviewed for the same reason. Three phases is a pattern, not an accident, and this stack should get an independent human or Codex review before merge.
